description: HackSlop is TUD team bringing together hardware engineering, planetary data science and web development. We focus on turning complex space data into tools that are accurate, intuitive and tangible, pairing rigorous validation against NASA sources with hands-on physical design. Our goal is to make mission-critical science accessible to planners, students and the public alike.
summary: We created an interactive lunar landing planner web application where we successfully tackled all criterions and went beyond by creating more than just the dashboard. We've polished this project to ensure its usage in production and to ensure the website runs smoothly. This project is important because it can help Lunar Mission Planners plan missions smoothly and with success.
